description: Verify persistent image inventory, authenticated reads, and immutable snapshot pagination.
preconditions: The registry roundtrip fixture is present.
assertions: Inventory discovers the pushed reference and its closure without creating tasks.

checks.description: Inventory discovers the pushed reference with complete verified local content.
Detail, objects, platforms, and summary use the same immutable snapshot.
Invalid filters and page sizes are rejected.

outputs: Snapshot ID, reference ID, closure size, and classification.
